categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and updates dependencies and patches under depends/packages/ and depends/patches/.
categories.rationale: Updating Qt to 6.12 LTS brings upstream platform support for macOS 26 and drops 11 downstream maintenance patches. According to the PR description, "Qt 6.12 LTS contains many bug fixes and officially supports macOS 26" while simplifying depends patches by 840 lines.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: The one-line addition to contrib/guix/symbol-check.py is a release build verification check that directly follows from the Qt update.
categories.rationale: Build and release integrity scripts belong to the build category rather than tools, and a mechanical one-line adjustment to symbol-check does not make this a tools PR.
